messages.subject: Plotting all items information in one graph
parts:
Hi folk

I have some questions.

- Can we show all items information in one plot, not different plot for one item.

- Can we insert a legend in plot function in 'mirt'. i have tried by usual R commands but it dose not work for me.

Best

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Plotting all items information in one graph
parts:
plot(mod, type = 'infotrace')

See the following in R for information.

method?plot("SingleGroupClass")

Phil
